name: Billit
description:
Billit is a global e-invoicing platform and certified Peppol Access Point. 

This connector gives Claude secure, read-only access to your Billit account, so you can ask questions about your invoices, customers, and suppliers in plain language — no documents are ever created, modified, or sent.
What you can do:
•	Invoices & credit notes — Look up sales and purchase documents, check payment status, find overdue invoices, and search by counterparty, date, amount, or free text.
•	Spending & revenue insights — Get per-customer or per-supplier totals across your order history, e.g. "How much did I spend per supplier this year?"
•	Customers & suppliers — Retrieve contact details, addresses, VAT numbers, IBANs, and Peppol identifiers for the parties in your account.
•	Company registry lookup — Search the public Belgian company registry (CBE/KBO) by name or VAT number to find official company data.
•	Peppol verification — Check whether any company can receive electronic invoices over the Peppol network, and which document types it supports, before you send.

Example prompts:
•	"Show my unpaid invoices from the last quarter"
•	"How much did I spend per supplier this year?"
•	"Can I send an e-invoice to Acme NV?"

Who it's for: Businesses, freelancers, and accountants using Billit for invoicing and Peppol e-invoicing across the globe. Multi-company accounts are fully supported. Enabling Claude to work with any company you administer.
Authentication uses OAuth 2.0: you sign in with your own Billit credentials and can revoke access at any time. All access is read-only.

For more info or help go to https://my.billit.eu then login and click help.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Billit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Billit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.my.billit.eu/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Billit MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Billit provides these MCP tools: check_peppol_participant, get_account_information, get_order, get_party, list_orders, list_parties, search_companies, and summarize_orders.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Billit?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Billit in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Billit requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Billit is developed by Billit. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
